note: source_photo.png is the photo as sent (736 x 1308, draped with folds). Maps use rows 860-1260 only (the flattest, evenly lit band): linear colour per channel divided by a 60 px blur and multiplied back to the mean colour, mirrored 2 x 2 so it repeats without a seam (1472 x 800). The crop mean (linear [0.0254, 0.0122, 0.0074], luminance 0.0147) is lifted, same hue, to luminance 0.022 so the box does not vanish on black: colour map mean [0.0381, 0.0183, 0.0112] (sRGB about #37251B). Height = the luminance relief, softened 1 px, stretched 0.5-99.5 percentile to 0-1. brown_leather_normal_gl.png: OpenGL normal map from the height at 35 % of the 0.1 mm render relief. Scale assumed: the photo spans 100 mm, so the tile is 200 x 109 mm. brown_leather_color_glb.jpg: the colour map as JPEG q90 for the GLB swatch.
